## Root cause The same error text was read two ways because it was classified from two different inputs, and on one of them the credit words came from a code field, not from what the vendor said. SenseNova's token-plan gateway (`token.sensenova.cn`) answers its throttle in OpenAI's shape: `code: "insufficient_quota"` beside `type: "rate_limit_error"` and the message `inference exceeds tpm/rpm limit` (that gateway reuses `insufficient_quota` as its throttle code — it does not mean the pool is spent; your own readings had 97% of the pool readings above 50%, none of the texts of the day says anything of money). In `failure()` the bare string check ```go || bytes.Contains(body, []byte("insufficient_quota")) ``` took any such body, at **any status**, for out of credit — the credit case sits before the per-minute case, so `type: "rate_limit_error"` and the `tpm/rpm` wording never got a say — and the account rested `creditRest` (30 min, `rest.by = "credit"`), which is exactly the 24 `glm-5.2` records: `until − trigger` = 1800.3–1804.8 s, `fail`/`rest.why`/`rest.by` all `credit`. The other verdict came from the last candidate's booking, which reads the failure from the words magpie gave the agent (`"SenseNova: inference exceeds tpm/rpm limit"`, no `code`/`type` fields) — on those words the per-minute case answers and it is a rate limit. Hence one text, two verdicts, the same day: `deepseek-flash` 910 rate / 0 credit, `glm-5.2` 123 rate / 24 credit. Why the two models differ: the credit reading needs the raw body's `insufficient_quota` code, so it appears only where the upstream pool's gateway writes that code (glm's pool); that part rests on the counts above, since `tries[]` keeps no raw body (your point 4). ## Fix `internal/gateway/routing.go`, two touches: - the credit case: an `insufficient_quota` code no longer makes credit when the body's own words name a rate per minute (`minuteWords`, nothing longer or spent beside them) — the code is the gateway's throttle code, not its balance; - the 429 per-minute case reads `minuteRate` (the old `minuteLimit` without its now-unreachable `insufficient_quota` bar), so the same body is a rate limit whichever input it is classified from — the verdict no longer depends on the booking path. Unchanged on purpose: OpenAI's own out-of-credit (its message names no rate), Zhipu's 1113 `余额不足`, WorkBuddy's credits-exhausted (all still `failCredit`), and Gemini/Azure's per-minute quota wordings (already `failRate`). ## Verification | Check | Result | | --- | --- | | `TestRateLimitIsNotQuota` with the gateway's body as it comes and as magpie words it | RED before (`credit, want rate`) → GREEN after | | Ablation (revert `routing.go` to the parent, keep the test) | RED again | | Restore | GREEN | | `go test -tags nogui -timeout 25m ./internal/gateway/...` | ok (623s) | | `go test -tags nogui -race -run 'TestRateLimitIsNotQuota\|TestFailure\|TestRest\|TestCredit' ./internal/gateway/` | ok | | `gofmt -l` on the two files / `go vet -tags nogui ./internal/gateway/` | clean | | `go build ./...` | ok (pre-existing darwin cgo warnings in `internal/gui` only) | Sibling sweep: every other `insufficient_quota` fixture in the tree (OpenAI real quota, spend limit, legacy, WorkBuddy 14018, `"code":"insufficient_quota"` alone) has no per-minute wording — none flips; `minuteRate` is a strict superset of the old `minuteLimit` for bodies without the code, so Gemini/Azure rows are untouched. ## Sources - the 429 shape (`code=insufficient_quota`, `type=rate_limit_error`, message `inference exceeds tpm/rpm limit`): [dsh-autoresume plugin notes](https://deepshplugins.com/plugins/dsh-autoresume) - the uniformly-formatted 429 body at `token.sensenova.cn`: [Phoeky/st-rotator README](https://github.com/Phoeky/st-rotator/blob/main/README.md), [CSDN: SenseNova gateway is OpenAI-compatible](https://blog.csdn.net/user_admin_god/article/details/166370632) ## Not verified - no live SenseNova account here: the raw 429 body shape is taken from the public sources above and from your records' verdicts, not reproduced against the vendor; - whether deepseek-flash's pool writes the same code could not be pinned from the data you have (no raw bodies in `tries[]`) — if it does and still reads all-rate everywhere, tell me and I'll re-examine.
Patch (git am format) — SHA-256 (first 16): 4efce5a8945bba00 ``` From a2b76e64f281dff3797d0f6234c066321fb1b4b1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001 From: ggbdpq Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 05:51:06 +0800 Subject: [PATCH] gateway: a 429 whose quota code rides beside a per-minute wording is a rate limit (#5006) MIME-Version: 1.0 Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8 Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit SenseNova's token-plan gateway answers its throttle in OpenAI's shape: the code insufficient_quota beside the type rate_limit_error and the message "inference exceeds tpm/rpm limit". The bare string check took any such body, at any status, for out of credit — over a pool half up — and parked the account the half hour of a top-up, while the last candidate's failure was booked from the words magpie gave the agent, which say a per-minute rate: the same text was rate and credit the same day, glm-5.2's 24 credit rests beside its 123 rate ones, deepseek-flash's 910 rate and none credit. An insufficient_quota that words a rate per minute (minuteWords, nothing longer or spent beside it) is a rate limit now, on the body as the words were; OpenAI's own out-of-credit (its message names no rate) reads credit as before, as does Zhipu's 1113. TestRateLimitIsNotQuota has the gateway's body as it comes and as magpie words it, and fails without the change. Fixes #5006 Generated-by: GLM-5.3-Flash (ZCode) --- internal/gateway/ratewords_test.go | 7 +++++++ internal/gateway/routing.go | 22 +++++++++++++++------- 2 files changed, 22 insertions(+), 7 deletions(-) diff --git a/internal/gateway/ratewords_test.go b/internal/gateway/ratewords_test.go index e9fd89bba..1e8a6afc2 100644 --- a/internal/gateway/ratewords_test.go +++ b/internal/gateway/ratewords_test.go @@ -22,6 +22,13 @@ func TestRateLimitIsNotQuota(t *testing.T) { `{"error":{"code":"1113","message":"余额不足或无可用资源包,请充值。"}}`: failCredit, `{"error":{"message":"Zhipu GLM: 余额不足或无可用资源包,请充值。","type":"rate_limit_error"}}`: failCredit, `{"error":{"code":"1113","message":"Insufficient balance or no resource package. Please recharge."}}`: failCredit, + // SenseNova's token-plan gateway answers its throttle in OpenAI's + // shape, the code insufficient_quota beside the type + // rate_limit_error and a per-minute message, over a pool half up + // (hzyqn: the same text read credit from the body and rate from + // the words magpie gave the agent, #5006) + `{"error":{"code":"insufficient_quota","message":"inference exceeds tpm/rpm limit","type":"rate_limit_error"}}`: failRate, + `SenseNova: inference exceeds tpm/rpm limit`: failRate, } { if got := failure(429, []byte(body)); got != want { t.Errorf("%s: %s, want %s", body, got, want) diff --git a/internal/gateway/routing.go b/internal/gateway/routing.go index 694a71394..488af231d 100644 --- a/internal/gateway/routing.go +++ b/internal/gateway/routing.go @@ -520,7 +520,8 @@ func failure(status int, body []byte) string { // Standard's pool, which counts some models only, and read as the // account out of credit it rested Droid Core with it (#1979) return failQuota - case status == 402, creditWords.Match(body) && (status != 429 || brokeWords.Match(body)) || bytes.Contains(body, []byte("insufficient_quota")): + case status == 402, creditWords.Match(body) && (status != 429 || brokeWords.Match(body)), + bytes.Contains(body, []byte("insufficient_quota")) && !minuteRate(body): return failCredit case status == 429 && resetsWhen.Match(body): // out until the time it names, in whichever language it said so: @@ -528,7 +529,7 @@ func failure(status int, body []byte) string { // English one as a rate limit, and each rested its own fallback // (#1669) return failQuota - case status == 429 && minuteLimit(body): + case status == 429 && minuteRate(body): // a limit per minute, whatever it calls itself: back in a // minute, not a plan used up (minuteWords) return failRate @@ -551,13 +552,20 @@ func failure(status int, body []byte) string { return failOther } -// minuteLimit says a 429's words name a limit per minute or less +// minuteRate says a 429's words name a limit per minute or less // (minuteWords), and nothing longer or spent beside it: no longer window -// (longWords), no balance spent (brokeWords, insufficient_quota). Words -// in a link don't count. -func minuteLimit(body []byte) bool { +// (longWords), no balance spent (brokeWords). Words in a link don't +// count. A body carrying the quota code insufficient_quota reads here +// too when its words say a rate: SenseNova's token-plan gateway answers +// its throttle with the code beside the type rate_limit_error and the +// message "inference exceeds tpm/rpm limit" over a pool half up — read +// from its body it was out of credit, from the words magpie gave the +// agent a rate limit, and the same text was both the same day (#5006). +// The code is the gateway's throttle code, not its balance: OpenAI's own +// out-of-credit (its message names no rate) reads credit as before. +func minuteRate(body []byte) bool { body = urlWords.ReplaceAll(body, nil) - return minuteWords.Match(body) && !longWords.Match(body) && !brokeWords.Match(body) && !bytes.Contains(body, []byte("insufficient_quota")) + return minuteWords.Match(body) && !longWords.Match(body) && !brokeWords.Match(body) } // dashScopeTokenRate: DashScope's (Model Studio's) 429 for the tokens -- 2.50.1 (Apple Git-155) ```
